# Next Elite - An open source production-ready Next.js starter kit

> A production-ready, frontend-first Next.js 16.4 + React 19.3 + TypeScript 7 starter kit. API-first with no bundled database, next-intl i18n, Better Auth RBAC, Oxlint/Oxfmt tooling, and a polished developer experience.

---

## 1. Project Metadata & SEO Tags

- **Project Name**: Next Elite (SaaS Boilerplate, Starter Kit, Template)
- **Framework Stack**: Next.js 16.4 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19.3, TypeScript 7, Node.js 22.12+
- **UI & CSS**: Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, CVA variants, design tokens, light/dark theme, RTL
- **Performance**: Optimized for Lighthouse (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO)
- **Primary Category**: Developer Templates / SaaS Starters / Next.js Boilerplates
- **Keywords**: Next.js 16.4, React 19, TypeScript 7, Better Auth, RBAC, next-intl, type-safe i18n, API-first, TanStack Query, sitemap, robots, llms.txt, T3 Env, Vitest, Playwright, Oxlint, Oxfmt, Lefthook, Knip, Sentry, Tailwind v4, SaaS starter, admin dashboard, frontend-first boilerplate, zero-database starter

## 3. Key Architectural Pillars

### A. API-First & Database-Free
Connects to any existing backend (REST, GraphQL, or BFF). No local database required. Server Components check auth and roles; the client caches live data with TanStack Query.

```
[User] -> [Server Component] -> [requirePermission() + Better Auth]
              |
              +-> Server HTML (next-intl messages from messages/)
              |
              +-> [Client] -> [TanStack Query] -> [Your Backend API]
```

### B. Feature-Based Structure
Vertical slices under `src/features/`:
- `auth/` - Better Auth server and client, RBAC (`rbac/`), auth provider hook, Zod schemas, server helpers
- `i18n/` - next-intl request config, cookie routing, locale actions, RTL hook
- `site/` - `site.config.json`, its schema, server-only base URL, locale helpers

UI lives in `src/components/`:
- `ui/` - shadcn/Radix primitives and custom components (cards, stat cards, charts, data table, forms, calendar, dialogs, sidebar)
- `shared/` - app-level pieces (page header, theme toggle, language switcher, user dropdown, top loader)
- `layout/` - app shell, admin and user sidebars, topbar, header
- `auth/` - login, register, and password reset forms
- `icons/` - icon registry and custom SVG icons

---

## 4. Feature Specifications

### Authentication & RBAC
- **Better Auth**: Email/password and Google OAuth via `/api/auth/*`
- **Roles**: `admin` and `user`; admin emails via the `AUTH_ADMIN_EMAILS` server variable
- **Permissions**: role-to-permission map in `src/features/auth/rbac/permissions.ts`
- **Guards**: `requireUser()` and `requirePermission()` in Server Components
- **Parallel routing**: `@admin` and `@user` slots share the same URLs (`/dashboard`, `/analytics`, `/profile`, `/settings`)

### Type-Safe i18n (next-intl)
- **Six locales**: English, Bengali, Arabic (RTL), French, Spanish, Chinese
- **Cookie locale**: `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie, no `/en` URL prefixes
- **Compile-time keys**: Invalid `t("key")` calls fail the TypeScript build

### UI & Design System
- **Design tokens**: light and dark tokens in `src/app/styles/tokens.css`, mapped to Tailwind utilities
- **Variants**: CVA-based variants on buttons, badges, status indicators, toggles, and more
- **Charts**: ApexCharts area chart, loaded only when it scrolls into view

### SEO, PWA & Agentic Browsing
- **Single config**: `src/features/site/site.config.json` drives metadata, sitemap, and manifest
- **Routes**: `sitemap.ts`, `robots.ts`, `manifest.ts` (`/manifest.webmanifest`)
- **Rich previews**: Open Graph, Twitter cards, JSON-LD structured data
- **llms.txt**: This file at `/llms.txt` for AI discovery

### Forms & Validation
- **Zod** schemas for login and register in `src/features/auth/schemas/`
- **React Hook Form** with `zodResolver`
- **InputError** and `ui/form` primitives for accessible inline field errors

### Testing & Quality Gates
- **Vitest** + React Testing Library; tests live in `src/tests/`, with a `renderWithProviders` helper in `src/tests/render.tsx`
- **Playwright** E2E in `e2e/`; CI uses the production server (Chromium)
- **Oxlint + Oxfmt** for lint and format; **Knip** for unused code and dependencies
- **Lefthook** pre-commit (oxlint + oxfmt), commit-msg (Commitlint), and pre-push (`npm run check`)
- **`npm run check`**: typecheck, lint, knip, and unit tests in one command

### Observability & Config
- **Sentry** on client and server; the browser SDK loads lazily, only when `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` is set
- **Vercel Analytics** rendered only when deployed on Vercel
- **T3 Env** validates environment variables on the server (`src/libs/env.ts`)
- **`GET /api/health`** for load balancers and Docker health checks

---

## 5. Quick Start & Setup

### Requirements
- Node.js 22.12+
- npm

### Local Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite.git
cd Next-Elite
npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:6767` (default dev port).

### Demo Credentials
When `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true`:
- **User**: `user@test.com` / `12345678`
- **Admin**: `admin@test.com` / `12345678`

Run `npm run demo:remove` to delete all demo code before building your own app.

### Docker
```bash
docker compose up --build
# or
docker build -t next-elite .
docker run --rm --env-file .env -p 6767:6767 next-elite
```

---

## 6. Scripts & CI

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `npm run dev` | Dev server (port 6767) |
| `npm run build` | Production build (standalone output) |
| `npm run start` | Production server (port 6767) |
| `npm run check` | typecheck + lint + knip + test |
| `npm run lint` / `lint:fix` | Oxlint + Oxfmt |
| `npm run test` | Vitest unit/component tests |
| `npm run e2e` | Playwright end-to-end tests |
| `npm run playwright:install` | Install Playwright browsers |

**CI workflows** (`.github/workflows/`): `check.yml` on push/PR (typecheck, lint, knip, tests, build, and a demo-removal check); `playwright.yml` for E2E.

---

## 7. Routes

### Public
- `/` - Home (marketing)
- `/ui-components` - Live component showcase (50+ components)

### Auth
- `/login`, `/register`, `/password-reset` - Auth pages

### Protected (role-based `@admin` / `@user` slots)
- `/dashboard` - Role-based dashboard
- `/analytics` - Analytics
- `/profile` - User profile
- `/settings` - Settings
- `/unauthorized` - Shown when a role lacks permission

---

## 8. Intended Use Cases

- **Best for**: Multi-role SaaS frontends, admin panels, ERPs, dashboards, multilingual apps (LTR/RTL), apps that consume external APIs
- **Not ideal for**: Simple brochure sites or apps that need a bundled ORM/database layer
